SKILL-SET-S1.change: Create Agent A SKILL SET: context (EP group analysis, IR guarantees post-fix), input files (ir-slice, source, semgrep, threat-context, output schema), tasks (read IR → read source → trace → check guards → refute → verdict), output rules (TP requires entry_point_id + source+sink file:line + reasoning; FP requires fp_reason + fp_evidence; REVIEW requires review_reason), scope (no cross-EP, no anomalies, no unresolved hooks), prompt structure example.
SKILL-SET-S1.note: If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins.

SKILL-SET-S2.change: Create Agent B SKILL SET: context (stored/cross-EP flows, 2-hop pattern), input (full IR, source, output schema), tasks (map storage writes → map storage reads → match by key → verify attacker reachability → check sanitization at both legs → output findings). Rules: entry_point_id MUST = load_entry_point_id. store_entry_point_id = write-leg. storage_key required when literal.
SKILL-SET-S2.note: If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins.

SKILL-SET-S3.change: Create Agent C SKILL SET: context (AnomalyRules 10 deterministic rules, structural flag only), input (anomalies from IR + source at evidence.file:line), tasks (read source → check defenses → verdict), rules (one anomaly = one finding, do NOT discover new findings, quick focused sessions). List all 10 anomaly types.
SKILL-SET-S3.note: If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins.

SKILL-SET-S4.change: Create Agent D SKILL SET: context (unresolved_hooks + coverage_gaps, IR-01 logs but Agent D resolves), input (unresolved_hooks section + coverage_gaps + source + output schema), tasks (trace dynamic hook expressions → if resolved analyze like Agent A → write to IR supplement; for coverage gaps: classify reason → find vulnerability → output REVIEW by default). Rules: use resolved_dynamic:<hash> as entry_point_id. MUST write resolved EPs to reports/phase1/<slug>-ir-supplement.json. State confidence level (high/medium/low). Sessions short (5-15 hooks).
SKILL-SET-S4.note: If spec here conflicts with source_ref → source_ref wins. IR supplement format (FULL — required for gate to validate normally per P1 post-review fix): {entry_points: [{id: 'resolved_dynamic:<hash>', type: <inferred>, file: ..., callback: {...}}], sources: [{entry_point_id: 'resolved_dynamic:<hash>', type: 'superglobal_post', ...}], sinks: [{entry_point_id: 'resolved_dynamic:<hash>', category: 'output', ...}], guards: [{entry_point_id: 'resolved_dynamic:<hash>', type: 'nonce_check', is_effective: true|false|null, ...}]}. Entry_points-only supplement is INSUFFICIENT — gate cannot run path_reachable or guard_consistent checks without sources/sinks/guards. Hash = sha1(file+':'+line+':'+resolved_hook_literal).
